author: IGN
description:
Don't miss the Red Band Trailer for Balls Up, a comedy film distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Secure a condom sponsorship with the World Cup in Balls Up, streaming on April 15 exclusively on Amazon Prime Video.

In Balls Up, marketing executives Brad and Elijah go “balls out” and pitch a bold full‑coverage condom sponsorship with the World Cup. After their drunken celebration in Brazil sparks a global scandal, they must outrun furious fans, criminals, and power-hungry officials to salvage their careers and make it home alive.

Balls Up stars Mark Wahlberg, Paul Walter Hauser, Benjamin Bratt, Eva De Dominici, Daniela Melchior, with Molly Shannon, Sacha Baron Cohen, and Eric André. The film is directed by Peter Farrelly and produced by David Ellison, Dana Goldberg, Don Granger, Andrew Muscato, Paul Wernick, and Rhett Reese.

Balls Up is streaming on April 15 exclusively on Amazon Prime Video.
title: Balls Up - Official Red Band Trailer (2026) Mark Wahlberg, Paul Walter Hauser, Sacha Baron Cohen

author: IGN
description: In FACES OF DEATH, the exploration of the original film’s infamous “is it real or not?” conceit continues as a woman (Ferreira) working as a content moderator for a major video platform discovers what appears to be re-enactments of murders from the original film. In an online world where nothing can be trusted, she must determine whether the violence is fiction, or unfolding in real time.
title: Faces of Death - Official Red Band Trailer (2026)

author: IGN
description: Set in seventh-century Arabia, Princess Hind (Aiysha Hart) defies her fate, refusing to become a concubine to the ruthless Emperor Kisra (Sir Ben Kingsley). Fleeing into the desert with her father, she is hunted by a merciless army and forced to trust a legendary bandit (Anthony Mackie) with secrets of his own. Rising from fugitive to fearless warrior, Hind unites warring tribes for a final stand—the Battle of Dhi Qar, a clash that will change history forever.
title: Desert Warrior - Official Trailer (2026) Anthony Mackie, Sir Ben Kingsley

author: IGN
description:
Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord sees the former Sith Lord rebuilding after his defeat on Mandalore in Season 7 of The Clone Wars. Maul voice actor Sam Witwer sits down with IGN’s Tom Jorgensen to explain how Maul - Shadow Lord’s unique, painterly art style and elements like physical brushstrokes and even some practical photography establish a visual identity for the series in keeping with the filmic look of the original trilogy. Witwer, who also played Starkiller in Star Wars: The Force Unleashed, muses on which Star Wars video game character he’d like to see canonized and what he considers the best execution of Darth Maul in a video game before the conversation takes an unexpected turn up the mountainous road to the Overlook Hotel, as Sam and Tom discover a mutual love of Mike Flanagan’s director’s cut of Doctor Sleep that winds all the way back around to an exploration of the similarities between Maul and The Shining’s Jack Torrance.

Star Wars: Maul - Shadow Lord debuts on Disney+ on
title: Why Sam Witwer Thinks Darth Maul Is Like Jack From The Shining

author: IGN
description:
Check out the trailer for Decorado, an upcoming fantastical animated horror film from director Alberto Vázquez (Birdboy: The Forgotten Children, Unicorn Wars). 

Something is wrong in the city of Anywhere. Arnold, an unemployed middle-aged mouse, confides to his wife Maria that he suspects his entire world is nothing more than a set, and his life a scripted performance. When his best friend Ramiro dies under mysterious circumstances, he traces the conspiracy to a monolithic corporation whose influence reaches every corner of their daily lives.

Ivan Miñambres, Chielo Loureiro, J.M. Fdez de Vega, and Nuno Beato serve as executive producers on Decorado. It is written by Alberto Vázquez and F. Xavier Manuel. Decorado features original music by Joseba Beristain. The Animation director is Pamela Poltronieri. The Art director is Jose Luis Ágreda.
